subject: reasoning
question:
E, F, G, H, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order).

Only two people sit between K and J when counted from the right of K. Only three people sit between H and F when counted from the right of F. J sits to the immediate right of F. G sits to the immediate right of L. Who sits fourth to the right of E?
solution:
Given:

 E, F, G, H, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only two people sit between K and J when counted from the right of K.

J sits to the immediate right of F.

Only three people sit between H and F when counted from the right of F.

G sits to the immediate right of L. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b83d82d9baa95c44630c11d79a43a54d5119308c69908326dd7d2096d1b1bdf1.png] 

Thus, G sits fourth to the right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
